subject.title: Slack Socket Mode events not reaching Gateway despite full config per documentation

question: Should this broad low-detail Slack Socket Mode report stay open separately until redacted diagnostics are added, or should maintainers consolidate it into the reaction-specific report based on non-public context?
rationale: The public issue body does not expose the attached report, so automation cannot safely decide whether the remaining work is a duplicate, a broader Socket Mode liveness bug, or a different Slack filtering path.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted Socket Mode status, raw event or absence evidence, config shape, and Gateway trace logs before changing code.

options.title: Consolidate Into Reaction Report
options.body: Close this as a duplicate only if maintainers know the missing report is limited to reaction add/remove events already tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56653.

options.title: Close Later As Insufficient Info
options.body: If no diagnostics appear after the issue reaches the stale-info threshold, close with a request for a fresh report containing reproducible current-main evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted Socket Mode status, raw event or absence evidence, config shape, and Gateway trace logs before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest current-history routing candidate for the Slack monitor and system-event paths implicated by the report.
